
[yellow bold]-- UNSAVED STORAGE -- main.volt:2[/yellow bold]

Storage variable `count` is never saved, so it resets to its default on every boot.

 [dim]1 |[/dim] 
 [dim]2 |[/dim] storage count: int = 0
 [dim]  |[/dim] [yellow]        ^^^^^[/yellow]

[cyan]Hint: Call `storage.save("count", count)` after changing it.[/cyan]
